DECLARE V_PROCESS_TYPE ICOMPODT.PROCESS_TYPE%TYPE; BEGIN SELECT Z.PROCESS_TYPE INTO V_PROCESS_TYPE FROM ( SELECT A.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT A , ICOMIVDT B WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRSTX-0001','KRSTX-0002','KRSTX-0003','KRSTX-0004','KRSTX-0005','KRSTX-0006') AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND B.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND B.INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ UNION SELECT A.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT A , WMSIVDT B WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRSTX-0001','KRSTX-0002','KRSTX-0003','KRSTX-0004','KRSTX-0005','KRSTX-0006') AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND B.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND B.INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$' AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ ) Z ;
IF V_PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN UPDATE ICOMIVHD SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL$' WHERE BUYER = 'KRSTX-0001' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'; ELSE UPDATE WMSIVDT SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL$' WHERE BUYER = 'KRSTX-0001' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND INV_SEQ = '$G_RS.INV_SEQ$'; END IF; END;
